children: Cocrystal Pharma announced the last subject has been dosed in its Phase 1b norovirus challenge study of CDI-988, with preliminary efficacy results expected late 2026 or early 2027.
Last subject dosed in Phase 1b randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled norovirus challenge study (NCT07198139).
Study evaluates CDI-988 as both a preventive and treatment; primary endpoint is reduction in clinical symptoms versus placebo.
No serious adverse events reported to date; CDI-988 previously shown safe and well tolerated in Phase 1 Australian study.
Secondary endpoints include viral shedding, disease severity, safety and PK; preliminary efficacy data expected late 2026 or early 2027.
